name: Rebuild Thumbnails Cache
description: Rebuilds the Windows thumbnail cache to fix missing, outdated, corrupted, or incorrectly displayed previews for images and documents. This clears old preview data so Explorer can regenerate fresh thumbnails; existing local copies of these files will be deleted.

description_i18n.en: Rebuilds the Windows thumbnail cache to fix missing, outdated, corrupted, or incorrectly displayed previews for images and documents. This clears old preview data so Explorer can regenerate fresh thumbnails; existing local copies of these files will be deleted.
description_i18n.de: Erstellt den Windows-Miniaturansichten-Cache neu, um fehlende oder beschädigte Vorschaün für Bilder und Dokumente zu beheben. Dadurch werden alte Vorschaudaten gelöscht, damit der Explorers neue Miniaturen erstellt; vorhandene lokale Kopien dieser Dateien werden entfernt.
description_i18n.fr: Reconstruit le cache des miniatures Windows pour corriger les aperçus manquants ou corrompus d'images et de documents. Cela supprime les anciennes données de prévisualisation afin que l'Explorateur régénère de nouvelles vignettes ; les copies locales existantes seront supprimées.

warnings.title: Local data cleanup
warnings.message: Cache or temporary preview files may be removed. Windows will take a moment to regenerate them when you browse folders again

warnings.title: Explorer refresh
warnings.message: Windows Explorer may close and reopen briefly while the cache is rebuilt

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: The script stops Windows Explorer, deletes all files matching the pattern thumbcache* in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer, and restarts Explorer to rebuild the cache
